abstract: Abnormal seminiferous epithelium with atypical germ cells was studied in 2 previous cases. Embryonal carcinoma occurred within four and one-half years of testicular biopsy. Herein is reported another case of bilateral carcinoma in situ of the testis, presenting abnormal germinal morphology and infertility. The abnormal cells differed considerably from normal spermatogonia, presenting an increased diameter and dense chromatin masses. Apparently normal tubules were also present with normal spermatogenesis. Serum gonadotropins and chromosome study were normal. After bilateral biopsy patient was submitted to a right orchiectomy and left varicocelectomy.
abstract_ja: 異常な精細管上皮と異型胚細胞は、既報の2例で検討されていた。胚細胞は生検から4年半以内に胎児性癌を発症した。本報告は両側精巣上皮内癌の別の症例であり、異常な胚細胞形態を示すが、精子形成が正常な精細管も存在する。異常細胞は正常の精原細胞とは著しく異なり、直径が増大し濃縮した染色質塊を有していた。両側生検後、右精巣摘除術と左精索静脈瘤手術が施行された。血清ゴナドトロピンおよび染色体検査は正常であった。
